projects.title: Judge Thredd Test
projects.description: A Discord bot for the Codédex server that tracks who answers the most questions in chosen channels and rewards the top helper each week with a special role.
projects.alt: Judge Thredd Discord bot cover image

projects.title: WLED lamp
projects.description: A smart lamp powered by an ESP32 Super Mini that drives a NeoPixel LED strip inside the shade. It runs WLED, so I can change colours, brightness and effects from my phone over Wi-Fi.
projects.alt: Twisted lamp glowing blue in a dark room

projects.title: SmartPack
projects.description: A backpack that checks your posture and tracks your route with GPS. Stretch sensors in the shoulder straps notice when you carry it wrong, and vibration motors warn you right away. A Raspberry Pi stores the data and serves a live web dashboard.
projects.alt: SmartPack backpack next to a phone showing the route dashboard

projects.title: OC: binary learning game
projects.description: A game that teaches binary numbers with cards on a table. A webcam spots red squares, and a blue card in a square counts as a 1. The program reads the row as a binary number, compares it with a random target and keeps score in a Tkinter window.
projects.alt: Illustration of red squares on a table, some holding blue cards, read as the binary number 01001101

contributions.title: FLY
contributions.description: A mobile arcade game made in Godot where you steer a fly past twigs and collect flowers for more stamina. I added the parallax background, saving of the high score, the game over screen and the lamp.
contributions.alt: The fly character from FLY flying past clouds, with a lantern below
